reconstructionPrompt:
Build a high-quality, production-ready component inspired by ambientCG (https://ambientcg.com/).
Technology stack: React, Tailwind CSS, TypeScript.
Component specification: 单个材质 Bricks 113 A 的详情页：3D 球体预览，1K 到 8K 的 JPG/PNG 贴图包下载及大小，标签、下载量和发布日期。

Visual details from source observation: 首屏是一整块铺满屏幕的 PBR 实拍图（苔藓上的石头），中间叠着 ambientCG 的球形标和一句 Free 3D Assets for Everyone and Everything.，下面一条下划线式搜索框写 Browse 2890 assets，右端一个放大镜。右上角是 All Assets › Surfaces › Environments › Substances › 3D 的面包屑，配 Supporter Login、License、Docs、Gallery 和社交图标。右侧竖排四块分类瓦片：PBR Surfaces、HDRIs、3D Assets、Substances。首屏下半还露出木纹与金属两张材质预览、一块粉色拉扣皮面和一张天空。
Ensure clean semantic markup, fully accessible ARIA roles and keyboard interactions, responsive layout across desktop and mobile, crisp typography, and fluid state transitions (default, hover, active, focus).
